{{Quote|I don't think we'll be seeing any of the weak vacillation and chronic self-doubt we saw in Holleck. Weizel has a track record for forging ties with political leaders in potentially unfriendly territory.|Greng Tabbe commenting on the replacement of Grandon Holleck as Governor of Chandrila|<ref name="GNN7" />}}
'''Greng Tabbe''' was the a member of the [[Imperial Public Policy Foundation]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Tabbe commented on the appointment of [[Gerald Weizel]] to the post of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] to [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily Newsfeed]].
